name: unit kernel
test:
out = gaussian_kernel(1, 2.0)
assert len(out) == 1 and len(out[0]) == 1 and abs(out[0][0] - 1.0) < 1e-12

name: analytic center and corner
test:
import math
out = gaussian_kernel(3, 1.0)
scale = 1 + 4*math.exp(-0.5) + 4*math.exp(-1.0)
assert len(out) == 3 and all(len(row) == 3 for row in out)
assert abs(out[1][1] - 1/scale) < 1e-9
assert abs(out[0][0] - math.exp(-1)/scale) < 1e-9

name: five by five symmetry and normalization
test:
import math
out = gaussian_kernel(5, 1.3)
assert len(out) == 5 and all(len(row) == 5 for row in out)
assert all(math.isfinite(x) and x >= 0 for row in out for x in row)
assert abs(sum(map(sum, out)) - 1) < 1e-9
assert all(abs(out[r][c] - out[4-r][4-c]) < 1e-12 for r in range(5) for c in range(5))

name: radial equality
test:
out = gaussian_kernel(5, 2.0)
assert abs(out[1][2] - out[2][1]) < 1e-12
assert abs(out[0][2] - out[2][0]) < 1e-12
assert out[2][2] > out[1][2] > out[0][2]

name: sigma changes concentration
test:
narrow = gaussian_kernel(5, 0.4)
wide = gaussian_kernel(5, 2.0)
assert narrow[2][2] > wide[2][2]
assert narrow[0][0] < wide[0][0]
assert abs(sum(map(sum, narrow)) - 1) < 1e-9

name: off-center weights depend on both axes
test:
out = gaussian_kernel(3, 0.7)
assert out[1][1] > out[0][1] > out[0][0] > 0
assert abs(out[0][0] - out[2][2]) < 1e-12

name: extreme finite spread
test:
import math
narrow = gaussian_kernel(3, 1e-200)
wide = gaussian_kernel(3, 1e200)
assert all(math.isfinite(x) for row in narrow + wide for x in row)
assert narrow[1][1] == 1.0 and abs(sum(map(sum, narrow)) - 1) < 1e-12
assert all(abs(x - 1/9) < 1e-12 for row in wide for x in row)
